Description: Digital elevation model (height above mean sea level). In the model, this is only used to calculate slope, which defaults to 0.0005 m/m. In the NanoFASE data module, it is used to calculate numerous [secondary variables](netcdf-namelist-input:secondary-derived-variables) for input to the model. Standard name: `height_above_mean_sea_level`
Also called surface runoff, this is the component of runoff that is responsible for driving soil erosion.  Standard name: `surface_runoff_flux`
Potential source: Usually obtained from a hydrological model

Description: This is the total runoff (subsurface and surface) that is routed by the model to provide surface water flows.  Standard name: `runoff_flux`
Potential source: Usually obtained from a hydrological model

Description: Amount of precipitation, used to drive soil percolation. Standard name: `rainfall_flux`
